hypothesis.claim: Applying the same causal residual-ratio correction to final coder odds while preserving the original expert and all parent learning improves native archives relative to the original integration and matched controls.
hypothesis.falsification: Any P/K or parent-state drift, prefix/rounding disagreement, noncausal update, inverse/repeat failure, or nonpositive native archive saving versus P and rotated S rejects this realization; resource failures are not scientific losses.

changedMechanism: Change delivery only: retain the original transformer output in the byte mixer; apply the existing ratio through conditional prefix-mass odds at the discretized final coder boundary. Keep observed/expected updates, prior32, clipping and256-symbol decay unchanged.
invariants: Owner root_explore, lenses8/9. No duplicate residual-suffix tree or fixed odds-ladder search; this uses the existing learned symbol-ratio policy with a separately diagnosed delivery question.
Synthetic arithmetic stage only: CPU3, one thread,512MiB address space,120 CPU seconds,120 elapsed seconds,32MiB per file,64MiB scratch and32GiB host headroom. No native corpus launch.

For the decoded prefix compute base masses P0/P1 and corrected masses Q0/Q1 from the205-entry native vocabulary. With final parent count p, A=p*Q1*P0, B=(65536-p)*P1*Q0. Output nearest-even65536*A/(A+B), clipped1..65535.

Use exact unsigned128 arithmetic with sixteen division steps rather than multiplying a potentially large numerator by65536. Native float rows convert exactly into2^-45 units; original floor1e-6 and corrected minimum floor/4 bound the shift.

When either base branch is empty the correction is neutral. Missing initial row is neutral. Identical or proportional rows preserve the exact parent integer probability. Reject invalid parent count, prefix, alphabet, bounds or support.
Do not overwrite measured sources. The stateless kernel owns no learning or hidden state; future adapter must retain and witness every cached row, ratio state and parent projection.

P unchanged. K runs all ratio and prefix arithmetic with zero injection. D uses causal correction. S uses the existing rotated-truth ratio control. First byte is unchanged; final pending prediction stays unobserved.

Synthetic tests must compare the native kernel against independent arbitrary-precision rational arithmetic, including extreme mass bounds, sparse prefixes, midpoint ties and nonfinite floats. A separate native adapter/gate must be frozen and published afterward.
No archive saving, model gain or full-corpus score is claimed by this stage. Independent exact native reconstruction/repeats and fresh complete package accounting remain necessary.
